[SWS_CRYPT_04208]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The function
ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::AllocVolatileContainer
shall allocate a volatile buffer with suffi-
cient size to hold cryptographic data of the provided capacity and the meta-data as-
sociated with each CryptoObject. The function shall return an instance of VolatileTrust-
edContainer representing the allocated buffer or
kInsufficientResource
, if not
enough volatile memory is available for allocation.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02004)
This type of containers could be used for execution of import operations described
above.
